title: incident-bot: oncall runbook & auto-diagnostics enhancements (SLO toolkit integration)
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Improve on-call experience by linking incident-bot runbook suggestions to SLO context and automated diagnostics. This PR integrates sleeker SLO toolkit hints into runbook suggestions, adds a prioritized scoring heuristic for candidate runbooks, surfaces automated diagnostics directly in oncall messages, and introduces a feature-flagged rollout for the new telemetry hooks.

What this changes: 1) SLO context enrichment: incident messages now include SLO name, burn rate, and recent error clusters when available (via the slo-toolkit API). 2) Runbook scoring: new heuristic ranks runbooks by recent success rate, applicability score, and recency; includes a small ML-derived fallback weighting. 3) Auto-diagnostics linking: diagnostics run results are attached as compact summaries with quick-link deep-links to runbook sections. 4) Oncall helpers: add `/incident suggest-runbook` quick action to surface top-3 runbooks and diagnostics. 5) Telemetry: emit new metrics (runbook_suggested, runbook_selected, diag_run_latency) and tracing spans for diagnostics runs. 6) Tests: unit and integration coverage added; e2e harness updated for canary rollout.

Checklist: - [x] Add SLO toolkit client adapter and rate-limited cache - [x] Implement runbook scoring and ranking service - [x] Attach compact diagnostics summaries to messages - [x] Add feature flag and rollout config - [x] Add unit/integration tests and update e2e harness - [x] Update docs and runbook metadata schema examples

Backward compatibility & rollout: The feature is behind the `oncall_autodiag_v2` feature flag and defaults to off. Existing behavior preserved for customers without slo-toolkit data. Telemetry fields are additive only.

Notes: See linked Linear tasks for details on scoring parameters and ML weight tuning. SUP-1284 contains customer repros that motivated the compact diagnostics summaries for heavy SLO-driven incidents.
